newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Sth Australia to scrap five percent energy levy.
newsitem.headline: Sth Australia to scrap five percent energy levy.

text.p: The state government of South Australia said on Thursday that it would abolish the five percent levy imposed on the sales of electricity and gas in the state.
Announcing the move in the 1997/8 state budget, treasurer Stephen Baker said the electricity levy would be scrapped on or after July 1 this year with no impact on the budget.
Baker said the gas levy would be progressively phased out over five years from 1997/98 with a net accumulative impact of A$13.5 million.
He said gaming machine revenue in 1996/97 was expected to fall A$11 million short of the A$146 million agreed to by hotels and clubs. Legislative provision to make up the difference would be applied.
Legislation had also been introduced allowing payroll tax incentives to be provided upfront rather than as rebates in a bid to boost youth employment and exports.
